title: Easy Jump Pad
description: Create customizable jump pats with ease
body:
## Easy Jump Pads

Enhance your server with lightweight, fully customizable jump pads that are simple to use and built for performance.

- Customizable
  
  Easily define the jump force for each individual jump pad to create unique experiences.
  

- Optimized Performance
  
  Designed to have virtually zero impact on your server’s performance.
  

- Easy Configuration
  
  Manage all your jump pads from a single, clear, and user-friendly config file.
  

- Instant Updates
  
  No server restarts needed — reload your config in under 3ms and keep playing.
